What problem it solves: Scaling model size up to 3 trillion parameters makes serving extremely expensive and slow. Who benefits: Developers using the GLM Coding Plan and engineers scaling large language models. Why creators and developers should care: It demonstrates a viable way to get multi-trillion-parameter reasoning performance out of a much smaller 750B footprint.
